tips.title: Found a bug? Tell us
tips.body: Open the sidebar's menu > Help > Send Bug / Feedback and turn on Collect more data with an agent.

tips.title: Split the view by dragging
tips.body: Drag a session from the sidebar onto an edge of the chat to open it in a split beside it.

tips.title: Let a coordinator delegate
tips.body: A coordinator hands work to threads and brings results back. Press {key:openNewThreadPalette} and pick Coordinator.

tips.title: Ghostex on your phone
tips.body: Open the sidebar's menu > Connect a Device and scan the code with the Ghostex app to follow your agents.

tips.title: Read chats in Quiet View
tips.body: More actions (⋯) > View > Quiet View folds the work between two replies into one line you can open.

tips.title: Everything waiting on you
tips.body: In a coordinator's chat, what waits on you sits in a list above the chat box. Answer or snooze it there.

tips.title: Dictate instead of typing
tips.body: Press the microphone beside Send, or {key:toggleDictation}, and talk. Your words land in the chat box for you to check.

tips.title: Talk to your agents
tips.body: Press the headset at the top of the window ({key:toggleVoiceAgent}) and ask out loud what your sessions are doing.

tips.title: Group projects into Spaces
tips.body: Turn on Spaces in Settings > Sidebar & Sessions, then swipe sideways on the sidebar to switch.

tips.title: Every session in one list
tips.body: The sidebar's menu > Sort & Filter > Switch to Unified View lists every session from every project.

tips.title: Find any command fast
tips.body: Press {key:openCommandPalette}, or pick Commands in the sidebar's menu, to search every Ghostex action and setting by name.

tips.title: Jump to sessions and files
tips.body: {key:openSessionSearchPalette} opens your recent sessions and {key:openQuickAccessFiles} the files of every project. Type a few letters, then Enter.

tips.title: Search inside a chat
tips.body: Press {key:findInFocusedView} in a chat to find any word. Enter goes to older matches and Shift+Enter comes back.

tips.title: Stash a prompt for later
tips.body: {key:stashPrompt} stashes what is in the chat box, and {key:stashedPrompts} opens Saved Prompts to send it again later.

tips.title: Watch your plan limits
tips.body: The meters at the bottom of the sidebar show each account's usage. Click one for its limits and reset times.

tips.title: Switch accounts mid-session
tips.body: Hit a limit? In a Claude or Codex chat, More actions (⋯) > Switch Account moves to another account.

tips.title: Keep agents going while away
tips.body: Turn on Settings > Autopilot and Ghostex nudges stuck sessions and moves sessions off a usage limit.

tips.title: Run agents on another computer
tips.body: Settings > Remote > Add a computer connects another computer. Its projects and sessions join your sidebar.

tips.title: Run sessions in the cloud
tips.body: Connect a provider in Settings > Cloud Boxes, then pick Cloud Box in a new chat's bar.

tips.title: See what you turned on
tips.body: Settings > Extensions > On lists everything you switched on. The other tabs have more to add.

tips.title: Start anything in a keystroke
tips.body: {key:openNewThreadPalette} opens the New Thread picker: type to pick an agent, Coordinator, Browser or Terminal.

tips.title: Chat or terminal, your pick
tips.body: Press {key:toggleChatView} to flip a session between the chat and the agent's own terminal. The agent keeps running.

tips.title: Jump to what's waiting
tips.body: {key:jumpToLatestUnreadNotification} jumps to your latest unread notification's session, and {key:openNotifications} opens the bell.

tips.title: Drive the sidebar by keyboard
tips.body: {key:focusSidebar} moves the keyboard to the sidebar: arrows move, Enter opens a session, Escape gives the keyboard back.

tips.title: Change model and effort
tips.body: Press {key:openModelPicker} for the model picker. Enter makes a choice the default; Alt+Enter uses it in this session only.

tips.title: Focus on one pane
tips.body: When the screen is split, {key:toggleAgentsFocusMode} shows only the pane you are in. Press it again to bring the rest back.

tips.title: See every shortcut
tips.body: Press {key:openHotkeys} to open Settings > Hotkeys, where every shortcut is listed and any key can be changed.

tips.title: Copy the last reply
tips.body: {key:copyLastChatReply} copies the agent's last reply in this chat, and {key:copyLastChatCodeBlock} the last code block it wrote.

tips.title: Ghostex's manual in a terminal
tips.body: Run ghostex guide features in any terminal to read the Ghostex manual. Your agents can read it too.

tips.title: Change settings from a terminal
tips.body: Run ghostex settings list to see every setting, and ghostex settings set <key> <value> to change one.

tips.title: Find prompts from a terminal
tips.body: Type gx f in any terminal to search every prompt you sent an agent. Pick one and Enter resumes that session.

tips.title: Ask for pages and forms
tips.body: Ask an agent for a gx page (a mockup or a report) or a gx form (questions with choices).

tips.title: Charts right in the chat
tips.body: Ask an agent to show its numbers as gx visuals and it draws charts, tables and stat tiles in the chat.

tips.title: Every file the chat touched
tips.body: Press {key:toggleChatFilesLinks}, or More actions (⋯) > Files and links, for every picture, file and link this session used.

tips.title: Work on a fresh branch
tips.body: In a new chat's bar, pick New worktree and its base branch. Your first message creates it.

tips.title: Share a chat by link
tips.body: Press Share at the top of a chat, then Create link. Anyone with the link and code can follow along.

tips.title: Find sessions by prompt
tips.body: The sidebar's menu > Tools > Search by Prompt ({key:openFindPrompts}) searches every prompt you sent. Enter resumes it.

tips.title: Star prompts you want again
tips.body: In Search by Prompt, star the prompts you reuse so they stay at the top every time you search.

tips.title: Keep your computer awake
tips.body: The sidebar's menu > Keep Awake stops your computer from sleeping for hours, or until you turn it off.

tips.title: Schedule recurring agent work
tips.body: Open the Automate view to run an agent on a schedule. The sidebar's menu > All Automations lists them all.

tips.title: Keep todos in Beads
tips.body: Add your todos as beads in the Beads view, then ask an agent to work on the ready ones with high priority.

tips.title: Review changes in one scroll
tips.body: The Changes view shows your branch's changes as one diff. Comment on a line for your agent.

tips.title: Catch up on a session
tips.body: Turn on Settings > Chat > Catch me up button, then click it in an empty chat box for a summary.

tips.title: Hear replies read aloud
tips.body: Point at an agent's reply and press the speaker. Auto-read in More actions (⋯) reads each new one.

tips.title: Replies you can scan
tips.body: Turn on Settings > Chat > Marked handovers in every session for replies in parts: Done, Needs you.

tips.title: Manage your agents' skills
tips.body: The sidebar's menu > Agents Hub lets you edit your agents' skills, instruction files, hooks and MCP.

tips.title: Ask Ghostex AI anything
tips.body: The sidebar's menu > Ask Ghostex AI starts an agent that explains Ghostex or changes a setting.

tips.title: Sleep idle sessions
tips.body: The sidebar's menu > Tools > Resources shows each session's CPU and memory, and puts idle ones to sleep.

tips.title: Fork a session
tips.body: Right-click a session > Advanced > Fork ({key:forkSession}) to copy it into a new session and try another direction.

tips.title: Send a message later
tips.body: Type a message, then right-click the session > Advanced > Delayed Send to send it later.

tips.title: Leave notes on sessions
tips.body: Press {key:sessionNote}, or right-click a session > Note, to write down what's next. The note stays when you resume.

tips.title: Let agents use your apps
tips.body: Install Fast Computer & Browser Use in Settings > Integrations, then ask for /ghostex-computer-use.

tips.title: Agents that drive the Browser
tips.body: Install Embedded Browser Use in Settings > Integrations so agents can click and read Browser tabs.

tips.title: Prompt from any app
tips.body: Settings > Integrations > Floating Capture puts a small button over every app to send a prompt.
